summary: First-finish frontend smoke test of SeekProfit foundation shell. All 10 requested review flows verified end-to-end: unauth root redirect, protected /app/*, email+password login, demo-operator login, sidebar/header structure, Overview KPI/chart/feed, every sidebar route (Overview + 9 placeholders labeled 'Planned — Stage 2'), user menu logout + post-logout protection, mobile menu open/close on navigation, 404 for unknown routes, and zero console errors (Recharts width/height warning filtered as agreed).
passed: Email+password submit signs in and lands on /app/overview
'Continue as demo operator' (auth-demo-login-button) signs in and lands on /app/overview
AppShell renders app-shell-root, app-sidebar, app-sidebar-brand, app-header
Sidebar shows all 4 sections: Workspace, Data, Insights, Settings
Header shows workspace switcher, search input, and user menu trigger (notifications present visually)
Overview page renders page-overview, overview-chart, overview-activity-feed, overview-export-button, overview-date-range-button

All 10 sidebar nav items route cleanly: overview + 9 placeholders (revenue-recovery, profit-leaks, opportunities, action-center, data-sources, imports, ai-analysis, reports, settings) render placeholder-<slug> with 'Planned — Stage 2' badge
User menu trigger opens; app-user-menu-logout signs out and redirects to /login; /app/overview then re-redirects to /login
Mobile (390x844): desktop app-sidebar hidden; app-mobile-menu-button opens app-mobile-nav; clicking a nav item inside the sheet navigates and auto-closes the sheet
0 console errors after filtering known Recharts width/height mount warning
action_items: Optional (non-blocking): PAGE testids for placeholder pages (page-revenue-recovery, page-profit-leaks, ...) are declared in /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds.js but only 'page-overview' and 'page-not-found' are actually rendered. Placeholder pages use placeholder-<slug> instead. Consider either (a) also emitting data-testid={PAGE[slug]} on the PlaceholderPage root for canonical parity, or (b) removing unused entries from testIds.js to prevent future test drift. Not a bug — foundation shell behaves as specified.
test_credentials: Client-only stub auth (localStorage key 'seekprofit.auth'). Any email/password accepted; demo button also works. /app/memory/test_credentials.md not present — not required for this stub.
